# Pipecat Documentation

> Pipecat is an open source framework for building voice and multimodal AI agents.

## About

Pipecat enables developers to build conversational AI applications like personal coaches, meeting assistants, storytelling toys, customer support bots, intake flows, and social companions.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://docs.pipecat.ai/getting-started/overview): Overview, installation, quickstart, and core concepts
- [Guides](https://docs.pipecat.ai/guides/introduction): Function calling, telephony integration, deployment guides
- [Server APIs](https://docs.pipecat.ai/server/introduction): Python server-side API reference
- [Client SDKs](https://docs.pipecat.ai/client/introduction): JavaScript, React, React Native, iOS, Android, and C++ SDKs

## Key Resources

- [Quickstart](https://docs.pipecat.ai/getting-started/quickstart): Build your first voice AI agent
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.pipecat.ai/getting-started/core-concepts): Understanding pipelines, frames, and processors
- [Supported Services](https://docs.pipecat.ai/server/services/supported-services): STT, LLM, TTS, and other service integrations
- [Deployment](https://docs.pipecat.ai/guides/deployment/overview): Deploy to Pipecat Cloud, Fly.io, Cerebrium, or Modal

## Integrations

### Speech-to-Text
AssemblyAI, AWS, Azure, Deepgram, Gladia, Google, Groq, OpenAI, Whisper

### LLM Providers
Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Cerebras, DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama, Together AI

### Text-to-Speech
Cartesia, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, Google, OpenAI, PlayHT, LMNT, Rime

- [Changelog](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Latest updates
